# Security policy

CareerScope's security controls, threat model, privacy boundaries and known
limitations are maintained in the canonical [security documentation](../docs/SECURITY.md).

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not disclose credentials, tokens, private resumes, personal data or exploit
details in a public issue. Report suspected vulnerabilities privately through
the repository owner's GitHub security contact or GitHub's private reporting
mechanism when enabled. Include the affected revision, a minimal reproduction,
impact and a safe mitigation suggestion; redact all real user data.

We will acknowledge reports when practical, investigate against the supported
release line, and coordinate disclosure after a fix or mitigation is available.
The public issue tracker is for reproducible non-sensitive defects only.
